property_summary: For any (identifier, time, ancillaryData), a requestPrice call made by the optimistic asserter must actually emit PriceRequestAdded, which costs a substantial amount of gas; the mutant's emptied body consumes only baseline call overhead, so measuring the gas consumed by the call distinguishes P from M.
change_summary: Delete the emit statement so requestPrice no longer emits the PriceRequestAdded event.
